conditions: Record exact source hashes, worktree and authority cursor, CUDA/compiler/device identity, commands, exits and pre-existing failures.
No historical campaign is reopened; useful kernels and all on-path consumers have a named preserve/move/replace/retire decision.
cases: Existing Semantic Spine N1 acceptance and graph test discovery; baseline on the required V100 when hardware lease is available.

conditions: Native and compiler-origin descriptors compare every mathematical field while excluding runtime bindings/provenance.
Scalar contraction split-K sums partials; no edge-channel concatenation or implicit normalization is introduced.
Mixed-profile semantics and straight-line real-valued VJP versus storage rounding are explicitly distinguished.
cases: Same extents/different biological axes; orientation reversal; profile mismatch; unknown effect kind; edge-channel rejection.

conditions: State transitions, invalidation, generation overflow, lease replay, reader-return and teardown behavior are complete.
Update and publication share one mechanism; delta add and gradient-step convenience do not create separate storage owners.
Public declaration sketch and demo agree; no declaration is installed without real implementation.
cases: State-machine table covers uninitialized, published, borrowed, returned, updating and poisoned states.

conditions: Tests execute validation and equivalence, not only name tables.
Wrong order/profile is rejected before dispatch; valid native and compiler descriptors share the same validator.
cases: Host positive and adversarial calculus tests; copy/move of descriptors does not leave self-referential pointers.

conditions: One canonical relation/calculus contract links with existing spine and passes host tests.
Internal interface checkpoint published with exact headers and test evidence; no broad SDK or language work.
cases: Host compilation and calculus test.

conditions: N16 forward reaches the actual FMP1 kernel with correct non-square axes and element capacities.
N1 semantics and rejection behavior remain unchanged; empty support overwrites output with zero.
cases: Widths 1,16 succeed; unsupported intermediate widths fail honestly; zero rows, empty rows, irregular support.

conditions: Transpose reads the same physical weights as forward and produces source-axis N16 results.
Non-square adjoint calculation is correct and no logical weight repack is required per transpose.
cases: Irregular/isolated sources; mixed sign weights; forward/transpose adjoint against independent loops.

conditions: Every logical edge has exactly one physical gradient slot and inverse mapping; missing/duplicate endpoints remain the established explicit rejection.
Full-f32 profile executes without half conversion; mixed-profile sparse result uses exactly the same operand quantization as WMMA.
cases: Distinct edge sentinels, randomized logical input ordering, independent VJP, gradient input-version mismatch.

conditions: Both update styles change the authoritative physical plane, not a throwaway logical copy.
Small updates, ties-to-even, signed zeros and overflow behavior are tested against the stated rounding policy.
No topology reconstruction and no implicit canonicalization or hidden f32 master weights.
cases: Delta versus step with equivalent delta; alpha zero; update generation overflow; shifted overlap; f16 rounding boundary.

conditions: Publication happens after all writes; newly published generation is consumed on another nonblocking stream.
Owner can update after reader-return enqueues completion without host-wide synchronization.
No false generation advancement or successful-receipt emission after rejected/failed enqueue.
cases: Two update styles across at least three generations; delayed reader; immediate next forward; stale-generation rejection.

conditions: New mutable operations cannot be accidentally captured into an unsupported graph.
Fault-injection and ownership tests cover rejected metadata, partial enqueue and asynchronous-error observation.
Statistics are evidence counters updated from actual branches, not projected or constant expected values.
cases: Stale pointer/version; busy lease close; same-device wrong stream; empty relation; capture refusal; N1 graph regression.

conditions: Event-backed ready wait works on explicit nonblocking streams with no legacy-default-stream crutch.
No per-generation event allocation and no silent wait on an unrecorded event.
cases: Initial unready, monotonic generation, wrong epoch/device and failed producer enqueue.

conditions: Producer-ready and consumer-done edges are both explicit and tested without host/device-global sync.
A stale lease cannot release a newer reader; next mutation joins the correct completion event.
Pool exhaustion is explicit; the one-lease limit is documented as a bounded runtime policy, not mathematics.
cases: Delayed D2D reader; begin/begin rejection; stale return; return then immediate update; repeat on two distinct consumer streams.

conditions: Tests distinguish enqueue, ready and observed completion, including failure outcomes.
No use-after-free under valid leases; invalid borrower behavior is rejected where observable and documented otherwise.
cases: Long repeated-generation run; fault-injected event API; stream-local synchronization only at observation boundaries.

conditions: Legal N16 executes actual WMMA; unaligned pointers, short capacities, bad tile starts and K17 direct-ldm request are rejected or legally repacked before launch.
Every warp collectively reaches each WMMA instruction with uniform arguments; output scratch alignment is validated.
cases: K16 legal; K17 and K24 adversarial stride/offset; zero tile work; overflow; last tile at source/destination boundary.

conditions: Dense fragments plus residual cover every supported edge once, with no writes to fictitious padded-edge parameters.
Logical/physical/per-tile mappings are invertible on support; allocation sizes and tile amplification are accounted.
cases: Dense module plus irregular residual; partial tile holes; shuffled IDs; sparse-only; empty; overlapping hint rejection.

conditions: Pack and sparse fallback agree on the exact quantized input values and tail initialization.
Same-address new version forces refresh; same version may reuse only under the documented immutable-through-completion contract.
No hot allocation or canonical edge-value packing.
cases: Rounding ties, subnormal/overflow policy, reused pointers, NaN/inf propagation, poisoned padding sentinels.

conditions: Dense, sparse-only and mixed covers agree with independent quantized-input VJP; required dense and mixed fixtures actually launch WMMA.
Residual writes cannot overlap rectangular output ownership; every gradient slot is initialized each invocation.
cases: Forced sparse versus forced hybrid; exact cover partition; cancellation, nonfinite and empty cases.

conditions: Unsupported forced paths fail with a reason; sparse fallback is actually called where selected.
Mechanism availability and benchmark promotion are separate statuses.
No graph-wide planner, arbitrary-N family, Ampere pipeline or new precision portfolio is introduced.
cases: Dispatch negative controls; phase-attribution counters; forced-ineligible requests.

conditions: Compiler semantics no longer depend on an independent training object to establish mathematical meaning.
Update, publication and observation are distinct effects; unknown and misordered stages fail closed.
cases: IR copy/move; illegal stage order; wrong relation/gradient order; numeric mismatch.

conditions: The supplied closure source independently lowers into canonical descriptors equivalent to native construction.
Wrong symbols, shadowed identities, axis flips, undeclared outputs, unsupported syntax and ambiguous update order yield diagnostic failure.
cases: Positive demo source and multiple rejection cases; not a string-equality stub recognizing only the demo.

conditions: Native and compiler-origin requests share operation semantics, physical preparation and actual provider dispatch.
Generation/effect dependencies survive lowering; no compiler-specific execution engine or candidate semantics.
cases: Exact field equivalence; mutate one semantic field then reject; verify actual provider attribution in final GPU acceptance.

conditions: All supported closure effects have conformance tests tied to shared semantics; no fabricated substitute primitive remains on this path.
Deferred language features are explicitly listed and not advertised as working.
cases: Contract suite for both delta and gradient-step source forms; unsupported syntax remains failure.

conditions: Adjoint and finite-difference checks catch transposed axes, missing K sums and wrong edge mapping.
Zero/isolated support and deterministic f16 rounding cases are independent of GPU implementation.
cases: N1 and N16; high-bit identity differences; stable fixed seeds; signed weights and cancellation.

conditions: All per-edge and dense results meet declared policy-specific tolerances.
Forced hybrid dense/mixed fixtures record actual WMMA execution; fallback fixtures record actual sparse execution.
cases: N16 arbitrary input rebinding; residue mask/padding sentinels; instruction legality adversarial fixture.

conditions: Prelaunch rejection leaves outputs/values/counters unchanged; post-submission failures poison state and never report a fresh ready generation.
No topology rebuild or mandatory logical-order traffic occurs across updates.
cases: Single-field metadata mutations; count overflow; stale gradient stamp; no-op alpha; zero support.

conditions: Repeated updates cannot overtake a valid reader; returned lease cannot be reused.
No global synchronization is needed for hot publication; only observation and teardown may wait on documented streams.
Existing N1 graph replay still computes correct values and new capture behavior is truthful.
cases: Ready-wait, reader-done, teardown, event reuse, wrong stream, replay; Compute Sanitizer final run.

conditions: No missing GPU, skipped sanitizer or source-only capability record can be interpreted as a passed device acceptance.
Benchmarks preserve warm/cold distinction, live mutation state reset and exact fixture/seed/numeric provenance.
cases: Receipt tamper tests; dense-heavy, irregular sparse and mixed covers; multiple reuse horizons.

conditions: Host and CUDA targets link without adding planning/contracts to production include paths.
Every advertised RU1 provider has an actual symbol and executable test; no uncompiled code-only completion.
cases: Host tests plus build of exact CTest inventory specified in the acceptance matrix.

conditions: Normal demo links real Cellerator and sm70 implementations, not planning stubs or reference mode.
Exactly one topology preparation; both update styles and generations 1,2,3 demonstrated; real sparse/WMMA attribution printed.
The fixture is labelled synthetic and loss decrease is not a scientific learning-performance claim.
cases: Post-epic normal GPU demo, reference-only fixture run as separately labelled control.

conditions: Every required test executed with zero failures and no skipped device substitution.
Required memcheck has zero reported errors; racecheck/synccheck findings are resolved or an explicit bounded tool limitation blocks relevant completion.
No root closure on build-only evidence.
cases: Host contract/bridge; GPU numerical/binding/lifecycle; normal demo; N1 graph regressions.

conditions: Performance report separates mechanism correctness, reachability and promotion.
Dense, irregular and mixed workloads reveal costs and at least one negative control; no fabricated universal WMMA claim.
If no hybrid win is found, document evidence and dispatch consequences rather than hiding the path or launching a new optimization campaign.
cases: Repeated independent samples, identical rounded operands, own-state reset outside timed step, declared reuse horizons.

conditions: Every moved/removed implementation has a destination or reason and preserved regression coverage.
No duplicate canonical semantics remain on the new path; no unrelated adapter or model functionality is silently discarded.
Integrated relevant tests rerun after pruning.
cases: Reference/caller audit, link tests of remaining consumers and full RU1 regression.

conditions: All leaf tasks have reviewed evidence and required post-pruning hardware gates pass at the recorded source.
No full .cell, arbitrary-N, optimizer framework, graph-wide planner or mutable graph-capture claims.
Completion distinguishes actual measured performance from unresolved research and does not activate follow-on work.
cases: Final host/device/sanitizer suite and dual-origin demo; machine receipt coherence review.

sanitizer: memcheck all GPU binaries and demo
racecheck and synccheck on numerical WMMA/lifecycle fixtures

performance_promotion: Measured separately; no mandatory universal speedup threshold.
